// PACK 01_larency  files=53

// ===== 01_larency/larency/drawover-tiles__000__36_31.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/drawover-tiles.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 36 31
// image: -
// tile: 36,31
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: e2e5a099223e

NPC - 36 31
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setstring this.group0,treetop.png,2,0,0,64,128,2047,9,24,25;//image,width(height is tiles count/width by assumption)
  setstring this.group1,treetop.png,2,96,0,32,128,#v(0xE),#v(0x7FF),#v(0x1E),#v(0x1F);
  this.groups = 2;
  scan();
}

function scan(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4096;this.i++){
    this.cx = (this.i%64);
    this.cy = int(this.i/64);
    for (this.g = 0;this.g< this.groups;this.g++){
      this.check = 0;
      for (this.t = 0;this.t<sarraylen(this.group#v(this.g))-6;this.t++){
        this.ct = tiles[this.cx+(this.t%2),this.cy+int(this.t/2)];
        if (strtofloat(#I(this.group#v(this.g),this.t+6)) == this.ct)this.check++;
      }
      if (this.check == sarraylen(this.group#v(this.g))-6){
        setplayerprop #c,yes;
        showimg 300+this.i,#I(this.group#v(this.g),0),this.cx,this.cy;
        changeimgpart 300+this.i,
        strtofloat(#I(this.group#v(this.g),2)),
        strtofloat(#I(this.group#v(this.g),3)),
        strtofloat(#I(this.group#v(this.g),4)),
          strtofloat(#I(this.group#v(this.g),5));
      }
    }
    if (this.i%(1000/this.groups) == 0)sleep .05;//avoid exceeding the loop limit
  }
}

NPCEND

// ===== 01_larency/larency/drop_template__000__0_0.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/drop_template.txt
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 0 0
// image: -
// tile: 0,0
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 5c7a6ae506e8

NPC - 0 0
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setshape 1,32,32;
  this.timer = timevar+1;
  timereverywhere;
  setstring this.callweapon,-systems/weaponmanager;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  if (timevar > this.timer && strequals(#P1(-1),))destroy;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (actionGrab){
  if (strequals(#P1(-1),))return;
  setstring client.tempwep,#P1(-1);
  setstring this.name,"#I(client.tempwep,0)";

  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),#s(this.callweapon)))callweapon this.i,addweapon,;
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),-systems/notify))callweapon this.i,addnotification,Picked up #I(client.tempwep,2) #I(client.tempwep,0),#I(client.tempwep,1);
  }
  destroy;
}

if (actionDrop){
  if (!strequals(#P1(-1),))return;
  this.index = strtofloat(#p(0));
  setcharprop #P1,#s(client.wep#v(this.index));

  triggeraction 0,0,gr.appendfile,DropLog.txt,#a dropped:#I(client.wep#v(this.index),2)x#I(client.wep#v(this.index),0);//Record the drop

  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){//Delete the weapon
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),#s(this.callweapon)))callweapon this.i,deleteweapon,#v(this.index);
  }

  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){//Update the inventory
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),-systems/inventory))callweapon this.i,forceUpdate,;
  }

  tokenize #P1(-1);
  setimg #t(1);
  message #t(2);
}

NPCEND

// ===== 01_larency/larency/fireworks__000__31_38.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/fireworks.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 31 38
// image: -
// tile: 31,38
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: c44adfbd02c5

NPC - 31 38
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  this.speed = 20;
  this.tail = 4;
  this.projectiles = {20,40};
  this.exploSpeed = 10;
  this.exploExpire = 300;//pixel distance
}

if (playerchats && strequals(#c,/showtime)){
  for (this.count = 0;this.count<int(random(4,7));this.count++){
this.rgb = {random(0,1),random(0,1),random(0,1)};

    hideimgs 300,300+this.size;
    this.tgt = {random(0,screenwidth),random(0,screenheight-100)};
    this.dist = screenheight-this.tgt[1];

    for (this.i=0;this.i<this.dist;this.i+=this.speed){
      for (this.t = 0;this.t<this.tail;this.t++){
        showimg 300+this.t,light4.png,this.tgt[0],screenheight-this.i+this.t*16;
        changeimgzoom 300+this.t,1-(this.t/this.tail);
        changeimgcolors 300+this.t,this.rgb[0],this.rgb[1],this.rgb[2],.4;
        changeimgvis 300+this.t,4;
      }
      sleep .05;
    }

    hideimgs 300,300+this.tail;
    this.size = int(random(this.projectiles[0],this.projectiles[1]));

    for (this.i=0;this.i<this.exploExpire;this.i+=this.exploSpeed){
      for (this.p = 0;this.p<this.size;this.p++){
        this.angle = (this.p/this.size)*(pi*2);
        showimg 300+this.p,tricxta_star-light.gif,this.tgt[0]+56+cos(this.angle)*this.i,this.tgt[1]+56+sin(this.angle)*this.i;
        changeimgvis 300+this.p,4;
        changeimgcolors 300+this.p,this.rgb[0],this.rgb[1],this.rgb[2],1-(this.i/this.exploExpire);
      }
      sleep .05;
    }
    hideimgs 300,300+this.size;
  }
}

NPCEND

// ===== 01_larency/larency/getPlayerProps__000__0_0.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/getPlayerProps.txt
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 0 0
// image: -
// tile: 0,0
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: d6681a988a4c

NPC - 0 0
if (playerenters || created || timeout){
  timeout = 0.05;
  setstring this.returnAcc,*PARM0;
  this.onMap = (onmapx(#L) == -1)?0:1;
  this.mapX = (this.onMap == 1)?(onmapx(#L)*64)+playerx:playerx;
  this.mapY = (this.onMap == 1)?(onmapy(#L)*64)+playery:playery;

  triggeraction 0,0,gr.es_clear,;
  triggeraction 0,0,gr.es_set,#a;
  triggeraction 0,0,gr.es_set,#3;
  triggeraction 0,0,gr.es_set,#v(this.onMap);
  triggeraction 0,0,gr.es_set,#v(this.mapX);
  triggeraction 0,0,gr.es_set,#v(this.mapY);

  triggeraction 0,0,gr.es,#s(this.returnAcc),receiveProps.txt;

  destroy;
}

// ===== 01_larency/larency/lockpicking__000__29_26.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/lockpicking.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC door.png 29 26
// image: door.png
// tile: 29,26
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: cee66f752aff

NPC door.png 29 26
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setstring this.img,kondie_pick-lock.gif;
  this.radius = 80;
  this.tolerance = .1;
  this.oC = {screenwidth/2-64,screenheight/2-64};
}

if (playertouchsme){
  this.target = int((random(0,pi)+pi)%(pi*2))+int(random(0,20))*0.05;
  this.sAngle = int(pi*1.5);

  disabledefmovement;
  set disableweapons;
  setani idle,;

  find_Pick();
  draw_base();

  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  if (this.picksLeft <= 0)quit();

  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
    if (keydown(this.i) && this.i%2 == 1){
      this.testAng = (this.sAngle+pi)%(pi*2);
      if ((!this.testAng<=0.1 && this.i==1) || (!this.testAng>pi-0.1 && this.i==3))
        this.sAngle += vecx(this.i)*.05;
    }
  }

  this.dist = abs(this.sAngle-this.target);
  //showtext 302,20,20,arial,l,#v(this.dist);
  //changeimgvis 302,4;
  if (keydown(5)){
    if (this.dist <= this.tolerance){
      hidelocal;
      quit();
    }
    else {
      this.showAng = this.sAngle + random(-this.dist,this.dist);
      replacestring client.wep#v(this.fInd),7,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.fInd),7))+this.dist);//add pick damage based on distance from target
      if (strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.fInd),7))>=20){//pick breaks
        break_Pick();
        draw_base();
      }
    }
  }
  else this.showAng = this.sAngle;

  if (keydown(6))quit();

  draw_Pick();

  timeout=0.05;
}

function draw_base(){
  showimg 300,#s(this.img),this.oC[0],this.oC[1];
  changeimgvis 300,4;
  showpoly 302,{0,screenheight-40,screenwidth,screenheight-40,screenwidth,screenheight,0,screenheight};
  changeimgcolors 302,,,,;
  changeimgvis 302,6;
  showtext 303,screenwidth/2,screenheight-20,arial,c,Picks left:#v(this.picksLeft);
  changeimgvis 303,7;
}

function draw_Pick(){
  showpoly 301,{
    this.oC[0]+64,this.oC[1]+64,
    this.oC[0]+64+cos(this.showAng-0.01)*this.radius,this.oC[1]+64+sin(this.showAng-0.01)*this.radius,
    this.oC[0]+64+cos(this.showAng+0.01)*this.radius,this.oC[1]+64+sin(this.showAng+0.01)*this.radius,
      };
  changeimgcolors 301,0.2,0.2,0.2,;
  changeimgvis 301,5;
}

function quit(){
  hideimgs 300,303;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),-systems/notify))callweapon this.i,addnotification,You have no lock picks left,tricxta_lockpick-icon.gif;
  }
  enabledefmovement;
  unset disableweapons;
  break;
}

function find_Pick(){
  this.fInd = -1;
  this.count = 0;
  while (!strequals(#s(client.wep#v(this.count)),)){
    if (strequals(#I(client.wep#v(this.count),0),Lock Pick))this.fInd = this.count;
    this.count++;
  }
  this.picksLeft = (this.fInd>=0)?strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.fInd),2)):0;
}

function break_Pick(){
  find_Pick();
  if (this.fInd<0 || this.picksLeft <= 0)return;
  replacestring client.wep#v(this.fInd),2,#v(this.picksLeft-1);
  replacestring client.wep#v(this.fInd),7,0;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 01_larency/larency/normal_bush__000__0_0.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/normal_bush.txt
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 0 0
// image: -
// tile: 0,0
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 95edb55a8fc2

NPC - 0 0
//Npc made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setshape 1,32,32;
  setimgpart #f,0,0,32,32;
  this.trim = 999999;
  this.growthTime = 5;//lots of 5 seconds:timevar

  showimg 300,#f,x,y;
  changeimgpart 300,32,0,32,32;
  changeimgvis 300,0;
  changeimgmode 300,1;
  changeimgcolors 300,1,1,1,.6;

  timereverywhere;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (actionHurt){
  putleaps 0,x+1,y+1;
  setcharprop #P1,#v((timevar%this.trim)+this.growthTime);
  hide;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.timer = strtofloat(#P1(-1))-(timevar%this.trim);
  if (this.timer <= 0 || this.timer>this.growthTime){
    show;
    break;
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

// ===== 01_larency/larency/normal_lockpicking__000__29_26.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/normal_lockpicking.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC door.png 29 26
// image: door.png
// tile: 29,26
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: a24f52370cf6

NPC door.png 29 26
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setstring this.img,kondie_pick-lock.gif;
  this.radius = 80;
  this.tolerance = .1;
  this.oC = {screenwidth/2-64,screenheight/2-64};
}

if (playertouchsme){
  this.target = int((random(0,pi)+pi)%(pi*2))+int(random(0,20))*0.05;
  this.sAngle = int(pi*1.5);
  draw_base();
  disabledefmovement;
  setani idle,;

  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  if (strtofloat(#I(client.lockPicks,0))<=0)quit();

  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
    if (keydown(this.i) && this.i%2 == 1){
      this.testAng = (this.sAngle+pi)%(pi*2);
      if ((!this.testAng<=0.1 && this.i==1) || (!this.testAng>pi-0.1 && this.i==3))
        this.sAngle += vecx(this.i)*.05;
    }
  }

  this.dist = abs(this.sAngle-this.target);
  //showtext 302,20,20,arial,l,#v(this.dist);
  //changeimgvis 302,4;
  if (keydown(5)){
    if (this.dist <= this.tolerance){
      hidelocal;
      quit();
    }
    else {
      this.showAng = this.sAngle + random(-this.dist,this.dist);
      replacestring client.lockPicks,1,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.lockPicks,1))+this.dist);//add pick damage based on distance from target
      if (strtofloat(#I(client.lockPicks,1))>=20){//pick breaks
        replacestring client.lockPicks,0,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.lockPicks,0))-1);
        replacestring client.lockPicks,1,0;//reset damage
        draw_base();
      }
    }
  }
  else this.showAng = this.sAngle;

  if (keydown(6))quit();

  draw_pick();

  timeout=0.05;
}

function draw_base(){
  showimg 300,#s(this.img),this.oC[0],this.oC[1];
  changeimgvis 300,4;
  showpoly 302,{0,screenheight-40,screenwidth,screenheight-40,screenwidth,screenheight,0,screenheight};
  changeimgcolors 302,,,,;
  changeimgvis 302,4;
  showtext 303,screenwidth/2,screenheight-20,arial,c,Picks left:#I(client.lockPicks,0);
  changeimgvis 303,5;
}

function draw_pick(){
  showpoly 301,{
    this.oC[0]+64,this.oC[1]+64,
    this.oC[0]+64+cos(this.showAng-0.01)*this.radius,this.oC[1]+64+sin(this.showAng-0.01)*this.radius,
    this.oC[0]+64+cos(this.showAng+0.01)*this.radius,this.oC[1]+64+sin(this.showAng+0.01)*this.radius,
  };
  changeimgcolors 301,0.2,0.2,0.2,;
  changeimgvis 301,5;
}

function quit(){
  hideimgs 300,303;
  enabledefmovement;
  break;
}

// ===== 01_larency/larency/normal_lockpicking__005__45_40.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/normal_lockpicking.nw
// npc-index: 5
// header: NPC door.png 45 40
// image: door.png
// tile: 45,40
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 777c82aca739

NPC door.png 45 40
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setstring this.img,temp_lock2.gif;
  this.oC = {screenwidth/2-64,screenheight/2-64};
  this.levels = 2;
  setarray this.track,this.levels;
  this.tolerance = 5;
}

if (playertouchsme){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.levels;this.i++)this.track[this.i] = random(0,100);
  this.levelSet = 0;

  disabledefmovement;
  setani idle,;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
    if (keydown(this.i)){
      if (this.i%2 == 0)this.levelSet = min(max(this.levelSet+vecy(this.i),0),this.levels-1);
    }
    else this.track[this.levelSet] += vecx(this.i);
  }
  message #v(this.levelSet);
  draw_lock();
  if (keydown(5))try();
  else if (keydown(6))quit();
  timeout=0.05;
}

function draw_lock(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.levels;this.i++){
    showimg 300+this.i,#s(this.img),this.oC[0]+this.track[this.i],this.oC[1];
    changeimgvis 300+this.i,4;
  }
}

function try(){
  this.tally = 0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.levels;this.i++)this.tally+=(int(this.track[this.i]/this.tolerance)*this.tolerance == int(this.track[0]/this.tolerance)*this.tolerance);
  message #v(this.tally);
  if (this.tally == this.levels){
    hidelocal;
    quit();
  }
}

function quit(){
  hideimgs 300,300+this.levels;
  enabledefmovement;
  break;
}

function read(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),#s(this.wep))){
      set disableweapons;
      this.call = this.i;

      dialinecount = this.linecount;
      diaquestion = this.questions;
      callweapon this.call,display,#s(this.icon),#s(this.diTarget);
      break;
    }
  }
}

// ===== 01_larency/larency/ranger-baddy__000__36_29.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/ranger-baddy.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 36 29
// image: -
// tile: 36,29
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 65c14c571b1e

NPC - 36 29
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #2,no-shield.png;
  setcharprop #3,xialza_head17.png;
  setcharprop #8,xialza_body13.png;
  setcharprop #P1,hat31.png;
  setcharprop #C0,orange;
  setcharprop #C1,black;
  setcharprop #C2,purple;
  setcharprop #C3,black;
  setcharprop #C4,white;

  timereverywhere;
  this.speed = 0.35;
  this.coolTime = 1;
  this.radius = 20;
  this.index = -1;

  this.fullhealth = 30;
  this.deadtime = 10;

  setstring this.ganis,idle,walk,shoot,dead,hurt,sword;//idle,walk,primary wep,dead,hurt,secondary wep
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  if (isleader){
    if (strtofloat(#P3(-1))>0){
      if (this.index == -1)findPlayer();//if no targeted player look
      if(this.index >= 0){//player found
        this.pCrds = {players[this.index].x,players[this.index].y};
        findTrack();
        if (!int(x) == int(this.pCrds[0]) && !int(y) == int(this.pCrds[1]) && !onwall(x+1.5+vecx(this.pDir)*2,y+2+vecy(this.pDir)*2)){
          dir = this.pDir;
          move();
        }
        else if (this.coolDown <= 0 && (int(x) == int(this.pCrds[0]) || int(y) == int(this.pCrds[1])))attack();
        else {
          findPlayer();
          setcharani #I(this.ganis,0),;
        }
        if (this.coolDown>0)this.coolDown -= 0.05;
      }
      else roam();//walk around randomly
    }
    else {
      setcharani #I(this.ganis,3),;
      sleep this.deadtime;
      revive();
    }
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (actionHurt){
  this.power = strtofloat(#p(0));

  if (strequals(#m(-1),#I(this.ganis,4)) || strtofloat(#P3(-1))<=0)return;
  setcharprop #P3,#v(strtofloat(#P3(-1))-this.power);
  setcharani #I(this.ganis,4),;
  this.angle = getangle((x+1.5)-(playerx+1.5),(playery+2)-(y+2));

  checkDeath();

  if (!strequals(#m(-1),#I(this.ganis,3)))knockback();
}

if (actionProjectile){
  if (strtofloat(#p(0))==2){
    if (strequals(#m(-1),#I(this.ganis,4)) || strtofloat(#P3(-1))<=0)return;
    setcharani #I(this.ganis,4),;
    setcharprop #P3,#v(strtofloat(#P3(-1))-strtofloat(#p(2)));
    checkDeath();
  }
}

function findTrack(){
  this.distS = {x-this.pCrds[0],y-this.pCrds[1]};
  this.dirS = {(this.pCrds[0]>x)?3:1,(this.pCrds[1]>y)?2:0};
  this.pDir = (abs(this.distS[0])<abs(this.distS[1]))?this.dirS[0]:this.dirS[1];
}

function attack(){
  this.distx=this.pCrds[0]-x;
  this.disty=this.pCrds[1]-y;
  dir=(abs(this.distx)>abs(this.disty))?2+this.distx/abs(this.distx):1+this.disty/abs(this.disty);
  if (this.pdist <= 3){
    setcharani #I(this.ganis,5),;
  }
  else {
    setcharani #I(this.ganis,2),;
    shootarrow dir;
  }
  this.coolDown = this.coolTime;
}

function findPlayer(){
  this.index=-1;
  this.distance=100;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<playerscount;this.i++){
    this.pdist=(abs((x-players[this.i].x)^2)+abs((y-players[this.i].y)^2))^.5;
    if (this.pdist<this.distance && !strcontains(#s(this.hiddenganis),#m(this.i))){
      this.distance=this.pdist;
      this.index=this.i;
    }
  }
  if (this.distance>this.radius)this.index=-1;
}

function move(){
  x += vecx(dir)*this.speed;
  y += vecy(dir)*this.speed;
  setcharani #I(this.ganis,1),;
}


function revive(){
  setcharprop #P3,#v(this.fullhealth);
  setcharani #I(this.ganis,0),;
}

function knockback(){
  setcharani hurt,;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<2;this.i+=.2){
    this.bx = x + cos(this.angle)*.4;
    this.by = y + sin(this.angle)*.4;

    this.check = 0;
    for (this.tc = 0;this.tc < 4;this.tc++){
      if (onwall(this.bx+.5+(this.tc%2),this.by + 1+ int(this.tc/2)))this.check ++;
    }

    if (this.check == 0){
      x = this.bx;
      y = this.by;
    }
    else break;

    sleep .05;
  }
}

function give_reward(){
  if (strequals(#m(-1),#I(this.ganis,3)))return;
  if (this.deathexp >= 0){
    for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
      if (strequals(#w(this.i),-systems/statmanager))callweapon this.i,addexp,#v(this.deathexp);
    }
  }
  this.dropang = 0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<sarraylen(this.loot);this.i+=2){
    if (random(0,1)<strtofloat(#I(this.loot,this.i+1))){
      putnpc ,loot_#I(this.loot,this.i).txt,x+1.5+cos(this.dropang)*2,y+2+sin(this.dropang)*2;
      this.dropang+=((pi*2)/sarraylen(this.loot)/2);
    }
  }
}

function checkDeath(){
  if (strtofloat(#P3(-1))<=0){
    give_reward();
    setcharani #I(this.ganis,3),;
    return;
  }
}

function roam(){
  findPlayer();
  if (this.walk <= 0){
    this.walk = random(5,15);
    dir = (dir+int(random(1,3)))%4;
  }
  if (!onwall(x+1.5+vecx(dir)*2,y+2+vecy(dir)*2)){
    this.walk -= this.speed;
    move();
  }
  else this.walk = 0;
}

function drawmessage(){
  hideimgs 310,315;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<min(dialinecount,4);this.i++){
    this.aind = (this.i+this.lineadd >= diaquestion && diaquestion>0)?1:0;
    if (this.aind==1)setstring this.text,#I(dia_line#v(this.i+this.lineadd),1);
    else setstring this.text,#s(dia_line#v(this.i+this.lineadd));
    showtext 310+this.i,this.ox+12+this.aind*20,this.oy+29+(this.i*25),#s(this.font),l,#s(this.text);
    changeimgzoom 310+this.i,this.zoom;
    changeimgvis 310+this.i,6;
    changeimgcolors 310+this.i,0.49,0.35,0.27,;
  }
}

function drawbase(){
  showimg 300,#s(this.img),this.ox,this.oy;
  changeimgpart 300,0,0,400,150;
  changeimgvis 300,6;

  showimg 301,#s(this.img),this.ox,this.oy;
  changeimgpart 301,0,150,400,150;
  changeimgvis 301,4;

  /*for (this.i=0;this.i<3;this.i++){
    showimg 302+this.i,#s(this.img),this.ox,this.oy+this.i*50;
    changeimgpart 302+this.i,0,300,400,25;
    changeimgmode 302+this.i,1;
    changeimgcolors 302+this.i,1,1,1,.2;
    changeimgvis 302+this.i,5;
  }*/

  hideimgs 306,307;

  if (this.lineadd>0){
    showimg 306,#s(this.img),this.ox+358,this.oy+124;
    changeimgpart 306,361,332,9,7;
    changeimgvis 306,7;
  }
  if (this.lineadd<dialinecount-4){
    showimg 307,#s(this.img),this.ox+358,this.oy+134;
    changeimgpart 307,361,342,9,7;
    changeimgvis 307,7;
  }

  if (this.lineadd+4>diaquestion && diaquestion>0){//question cursor
    showimg 308,#s(this.img),this.ox+8,this.oy+33+(dialinecount-this.lineadd+this.questionsel-(dialinecount-diaquestion))*25;
    changeimgpart 308,370,336,7,9;
    changeimgvis 308,6;
  }
  else hideimg 308;

  showimg 298,#s(this.diaIcon),this.ox+6,this.oy-0.5;
  changeimgpart 298,this.dID[0],this.dID[1],this.dID[2],this.dID[3];
  changeimgzoom 298,20/this.dID[3];
  changeimgvis 298,6;

  showtext 299,this.ox+200,this.oy+15,#s(this.font),c,#s(this.diaTarget);
  changeimgzoom 299,this.zoom;
  changeimgvis 299,6;
  changeimgcolors 299,0.49,0.35,0.27,;
}

function quit(){
  hideimgs 298,315;
  enabledefmovement;
  unset disableweapons;
  break;

// ===== 01_larency/larency/tricxta_items__000__27_25.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/tricxta_items.nw

// header: NPC tricxta_arrow1icon.gif 27 25
// image: tricxta_arrow1icon.gif

// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 5d5e626421b8

NPC tricxta_arrow1icon.gif 27 25
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setshape 1,32,32;
  setstring this.triggerweapon,-weaponmanager;
}

if (actiongrab){
  //name,icon,qty given,value,can drop(1 = true,0 = false),can stack(1 = true,0 = false),weapon
  setstring client.tempwep,"Steel Arrows", tricxta_arrow1icon.gif, 3, 2, 1, 1, basic_arrow, 2,tricxta_arrow1.gif;//param 1 = power, params2 = arrow image
  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),#s(this.triggerweapon))){callweapon this.i,addweapon,1;break;}
  }
}

// ===== 01_larency/larency/tricxta_notify__000__27_33.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/tricxta_notify.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 27 33
// image: -
// tile: 27,33
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: ecc9ab945216

NPC - 27 33
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setstring this.img,tricxta_notify-sprite2.gif;
  setarray this.notifytrack,4;
  if (!isweapon)toweapons -systems/notify;
  setstring this.font,#s(client.pFont);
}

if (addnotification){
  this.count = 0;
  while (!strequals(#s(this.notification#v(this.count)),))this.count++;
  this.count = this.count%4;
  setstring this.notification#v(this.count),#p(0);
  setstring this.notificationimg#v(this.count),#p(1);
  this.notifytrack[this.count] =  0;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.use = 0;
  for (this.count = 0;this.count<4;this.count++){
    if (!strequals(#s(this.notification#v(this.count)),))this.use = 1;
    else continue;
    this.value =  this.notifytrack[this.count];

    if (this.value<192)this.placex = screenwidth-this.value;
    else if (this.value < 900)this.placex = screenwidth-192;
    else if (this.value < 1160)this.placex = screenwidth-192+(this.value-900);
    else {
      setstring this.notification#v(this.count),;
      hideimgs 300+this.count*3,302+this.count*3;
    }

    if (this.value < 1160){
      this.notifytrack[this.count]+=20;
      draw_notification();
    }
  }
  if (this.use == 0)break;
  timeout=0.05;
}

function draw_notification(){
  showimg 300+this.count*3,#s(this.img),this.placex,102+this.count*40;
  changeimgvis 300+this.count*3,4;

  showtext 301+this.count*3,this.placex+42,109+this.count*40,#s(this.font),l,#s(this.notification#v(this.count));
  changeimgcolors 301+this.count*3,0.49,0.35,0.27,;
  this.twidth = textwidth(1,#s(this.font),l,#s(this.notification#v(this.count)));
  if (this.twidth> 150)changeimgzoom 301+this.count*3,150/this.twidth;
  else changeimgzoom 301+this.count*2,1;
  changeimgvis 301+this.count*3,5;

  showimg 302+this.count*3,#s(this.notificationimg#v(this.count)),this.placex+8,109+this.count*40;
  changeimgvis 302+this.count*3,5;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 01_larency/larency/tricxta_shop__000__21_27.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/tricxta_shop.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 21 27
// image: -
// tile: 21,27
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 2573ffb6ff0c

NPC - 21 27
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (!isweapon)toweapons -systems/shop;
  setstring this.img,riley_invent2.png;
  disableselectweapons;
  this.ox = screenwidth/2-200;
  this.oy = screenheight/2-100;
  setstring this.font,#s(client.pFont);
  this.zoom = 8.25/(textwidth(1,#s(this.font),c,ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ)/26);
}

if (openBuy){
  this.buy = 1;
  openShop();
}

if (openSell){
  this.buy = 0;
  openShop();
}

function openShop(){
  this.on = 1;
  this.sel = 0;
  this.pInd = 0;
  this.qtyadd = (this.buy == 1)?1:strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),2));
  this.aDown = 1;
  setani idle,;
  disabledefmovement;
  set disableweapons;
  draw();
  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (clearItems){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<shopIcount;this.i++){
    setstring shopItem#v(this.i),;
    setstring shopItemDescription#v(this.i),;
  }
  shopIcount = 0;
}

if (timeout && this.on == 1){
  this.itemCount = (this.buy == 1)?shopIcount:this.wCount;

  if (keydown(0) && this.sel>0 && this.keyd==0){
    this.qtyadd = 1;
    this.keyd = 1;
    this.sel--;
    if (this.sel<this.pInd)this.pInd--;
    draw();
  }
  else if (keydown(2) && this.sel<this.itemCount-1 && this.keyd==0){
    this.keyd = 1;
    this.sel++;
    this.qtyadd = (this.buy == 1)?1:strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),2));
    if (this.sel+this.pInd>=4)this.pInd++;
    draw();
  }

  else if (keydown(1) && this.qtyadd>1){
    this.qtyadd--;
    draw();
  }

  else if(keydown(3)){
    if (this.buy == 1 && strtofloat(#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),5))==1){
      this.qtyadd++;
      draw();
    }
    else if (this.buy == 0 && strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),5))==1 && this.qtyadd<strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),2))){
      this.qtyadd++;
      draw();
    }
  }

  else if (keydown(5)){
    if (this.buy == 1)buy();
    else sell();
    close();
  }

  else if ((keydown(6) || keydown2(81,true)) && this.aDown==0)close();
  else if (!keydown(0) && !keydown(2))this.keyd = 0;
  if (!keydown(6))this.aDown = 0;
  timeout=0.05;
}

function buy(){
  this.price = strtofloat(#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),3))*strtofloat(#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),2)) * this.qtyadd;
  //check players gold
  getGold();
  if (this.pGold >= this.price){
    setstring this.notifyimg,#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),1);
    setstring this.notifymsg,Bought #v(strtofloat(#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),2)) * this.qtyadd)x#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),0);
    replacestring client.wep#v(this.find),2,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.find),2))-this.price);
    for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
      if (strequals(#w(this.i),-systems/weaponmanager)){
        setstring client.tempwep,#s(shopItem#v(this.sel));
        replacestring client.tempwep,2,#v(strtofloat(#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),2)) * this.qtyadd);
        callweapon this.i,addweapon,;
        if (this.pGold-this.price == 0){
          sleep .5;
          callweapon this.i,deleteweapon,#v(this.find);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  else {
    setstring this.notifyimg,xialza_coins.png;
    setstring this.notifymsg,Insufficient Gold;
  }
  notify();
}

function sell(){
  if (strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),4))==1){
    this.aQty = strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),2));
    if (this.qtyadd <= this.aQty){//can sell weapon check goes here
      setstring client.tempwep,"Gold coins", "xialza_coins.png", #v(this.qtyadd * strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),3))), 1, 0, 1, normalItem;
      setstring this.notifyimg,#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),1);
      setstring this.notifymsg,Sold #v(this.qtyadd)x#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),0);

      for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
        if (strequals(#w(this.i),-systems/weaponmanager)){
          callweapon this.i,addweapon,;
          sleep .1;
          if (this.aQty-this.qtyadd == 0)callweapon this.i,deleteweapon,#v(this.sel);
          else replacestring client.wep#v(this.sel),2,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),2))-this.qtyadd);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  else {
    setstring this.notifyimg,#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),1);
    setstring this.notifymsg,You cannot sell this item!;
  }
  notify();
}

function draw_Base(){
  showimg 300,#s(this.img),this.ox,this.oy;
  changeimgpart 300,0,0,400,200;
  changeimgvis 300,4;
  hideimgs 301,302;
  if (this.pInd > 0){
    showimg 301,#s(this.img),this.ox+9,this.oy+9;
    changeimgpart 301,9,204,32,16;
  }
  if (shopIcount-this.pInd > 4){
    showimg 302,#s(this.img),this.ox+9,this.oy+175;
    changeimgpart 302,9,220,32,16;
  }

  getGold();
  showimg 297,#s(this.img),this.ox+310,this.oy+10;
  changeimgpart 297,136,204,80,32;
  changeimgvis 297,5;

  showimg 298,xialza_coins.png,this.ox+313,this.oy+10;
  changeimgvis 298,6;
  showtext 299,this.ox+344,this.oy+20,#s(this.font),l,#v(this.pGold);
  changeimgzoom 299,.5;
  changeimgcolors 299,0.49,0.35,0.27,;
  changeimgvis 299,6;
}

function draw_Items(){
  if (this.buy == 1){
    for (this.i=0;this.i<min(4,shopIcount);this.i++){
      showimg 310+this.i,#I(shopItem#v(this.i+this.pInd),1),this.ox+10,this.oy+24+this.i*40;
    }
  }
  else {
    this.wCount = 0;
    while (!strequals(#s(client.wep#v(this.wCount)),))this.wCount++;//find weapon count

    //draw weapons
    for (this.i=0;this.i<min(4,shopIcount);this.i++){
      showimg 310+this.i,#I(client.wep#v(this.i+this.pInd),1),this.ox+10,this.oy+24+this.i*40;
    }
  }
}

function draw_Sel(){
  if (shopIcount<=0)return;
  if (this.buy == 1){
    showimg 303,#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),1),this.ox+202,this.oy+20.5;
    showtext 304,this.ox+218,this.oy+90,#s(this.font),cu,#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),0);
  }
  else {
    showimg 303,#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),1),this.ox+202,this.oy+20.5;
    showtext 304,this.ox+218,this.oy+90,#s(this.font),cu,#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),0);
  }
  changeimgzoom 303,1.5;
  changeimgcolors 304,0.49,0.35,0.27,;

  showimg 305,#s(this.img),this.ox+4,this.oy+26+(this.sel-this.pInd)*40;
  changeimgpart 305,36,204,32,32;

  this.rawprice = (this.buy == 1)?strtofloat(#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),3)):strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),3));
  this.rawqty = (this.buy == 1)?strtofloat(#I(shopItem#v(this.sel),2)):1;
  showtext 306,this.ox+218,this.oy+160,#s(this.font),c,Qty:#v(this.rawqty)x#v(this.qtyadd);
  changeimgzoom 306,this.zoom;
  changeimgcolors 306,0.49,0.35,0.27,;
  showtext 307,this.ox+218,this.oy+180,#s(this.font),c,Price:#v(this.rawprice)x#v(this.rawqty*this.qtyadd)=#v(this.qtyadd*this.rawqty*this.rawprice);
  changeimgzoom 307,this.zoom;
  changeimgcolors 307,0.49,0.35,0.27,;
  wraptext 50, ,#s(shopItemDescription#v(this.sel));
  hideimgs 308,309;
  if (this.buy == 1){
    for (this.i=0;this.i<tokenscount;this.i++){
      showtext 308+this.i,this.ox+218,this.oy+110+this.i*20,#s(this.font),c,#t(this.i);
      changeimgzoom 308+this.i,this.zoom;
      changeimgcolors 308+this.i,0.49,0.35,0.27,;
    }
  }
}

function draw(){
  draw_Base();
  draw_Items();
  draw_Sel();
  for (this.i=300;this.i<315;this.i++)changeimgvis this.i,(this.i==300)?4:(this.i>=310)?6:5;
}

function close(){;
  this.on = 0;
  hideimgs 297,400;
  enabledefmovement;
  unset disableweapons;
}

function getGold(){
  this.find = -1;
  this.i=0;
  setstring this.itemFind,Gold coins;
  while (!strequals(#s(client.wep#v(this.i)),)){
    if (strequals(#I(client.wep#v(this.i),0),#s(this.itemFind)))this.find = this.i;
    this.i++;
  }

  if (this.find>=0)this.pGold = strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.find),2));
  else this.pGold = 0;
}

function notify(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),-systems/notify)){
      callweapon this.i,addnotification,#s(this.notifymsg),#s(this.notifyimg);
    }
  }
}

// ===== 01_larency/larency/tricxta_systems__001__23_7.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/tricxta_systems.nw
// npc-index: 1
// header: NPC - 23 7
// image: -
// tile: 23,7
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: e84959febcae

NPC - 23 7
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (!isweapon)toweapons -inventory;
  setstring this.img,riley_invent2.png;
  disableselectweapons;
  this.ox = screenwidth/2-200;
  this.oy = screenheight/2-100;
  if (strequals(#s(client.equip),))setstring client.equip,-1,-1,-1;
  setstring this.font,#s(client.pFont);
  this.zoom = 8.25/(textwidth(1,#s(this.font),c,ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ)/26);

  //Debug
  this.on = 0;
  this.keyh = 0;
}

if (keypressed && strtofloat(#p(0))==81 && this.keyh==0 && isweapon){
  this.keyh = 1;
  this.on = (this.on+1)%2;

  if (this.on==1){
    if (disableweapons)this.on = 0;
    else {
      disabledefmovement;
      set disableweapons;
      if (strcontains(#m,walk))setani idle,;
      get_weaponCount();
      draw();
    }
  }
  else close();

  while (keydown2(81,true))sleep .05;
  this.keyh = 0;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout && this.on == 1){
  if (keydown(0) && this.sel>0 && this.keyd==0){
    this.keyd = 1;
    this.sel--;
    if (this.sel<this.pInd)this.pInd--;
    draw();
  }
  else if (keydown(2) && this.sel<this.wCount-1 && this.keyd==0){
    this.keyd = 1;
    this.sel++;
    if (this.sel+this.pInd>=4)this.pInd++;
    draw();
  }

  else if (keydown2(46,true) && this.keyd == 0 && strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),4))==1){//delete
    this.keyd = 1;
    putnpc ,drop_template.txt,playerx+.5+vecx(playerdir)*2,playery+1+vecy(playerdir)*2;//create a heap
    sleep .5;
    triggeraction playerx+1.5+vecx(playerdir)*2,playery+2+vecy(playerdir)*2,Drop,#v(this.sel),#v(this.wCount);//add to the heap
    while (keydown2(46,true))sleep .05;
    draw();
    this.keyd = 0;
  }

  if (keydown(4)){
    replacestring client.equip,0,#v(this.sel);
    draw();
  }
  else if (keydown(5)){
    replacestring client.equip,1,#v(this.sel);
    draw();
  }
  else if (!keydown(0) && !keydown(2))this.keyd = 0;
  timeout=0.05;
}

function draw_Base(){
  showimg 300,#s(this.img),this.ox,this.oy;
  changeimgpart 300,0,0,400,200;
  changeimgvis 300,4;
  hideimgs 301,302;
  if (this.pInd > 0){
    showimg 301,#s(this.img),this.ox+9,this.oy+9;
    changeimgpart 301,9,204,32,16;
  }
  if (this.wCount-this.pInd > 4){
    showimg 302,#s(this.img),this.ox+9,this.oy+175;
    changeimgpart 302,9,220,32,16;
  }
}

function get_weaponCount(){
  this.wCount = 0;
  while (!strequals(#s(client.wep#v(this.wCount)),))this.wCount++;
}

function draw_Weapons(){
  hideimgs 310,316;
  get_weaponCount();
  for (this.i=0;this.i<min(4,this.wCount);this.i++){
    showimg 310+this.i,#I(client.wep#v(this.i+this.pInd),1),this.ox+8,this.oy+24+this.i*40;//draw icon
    this.qty = strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.i+this.pInd),2));
    if (this.qty>1){
      if (this.qty >= 1000000)setstring this.showqty,#v(int(this.qty/1000000))M;
      else if (this.qty >= 1000)setstring this.showqty,#v(int(this.qty/1000))K;
      else setstring this.showqty,#v(this.qty);
      showtext 315+this.i,this.ox+40,this.oy+26+this.i*40,#s(this.font),r,#s(this.showqty);
    }
    else hideimg 315+this.i;
  }
}

function draw_Sel(){
  if (this.wCount<=0)return;
  showimg 303,#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),1),this.ox+202,this.oy+20.5;
  changeimgzoom 303,1.5;
  showtext 304,this.ox+218,this.oy+90,#s(this.font),cbu,#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),0);
  showimg 305,#s(this.img),this.ox+4,this.oy+26+(this.sel-this.pInd)*40;
  changeimgpart 305,36,204,32,32;
  showtext 306,this.ox+218,this.oy+130,#s(this.font),c,Qty:#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),2), Value:#I(client.wep#v(this.sel),3);
  hideimg 307;
  if (strtofloat(#I(client.equip,0))==this.sel)showtext 307,this.ox+218,this.oy+160,#s(this.font),c,Equipped To D;
  else if (strtofloat(#I(client.equip,1))==this.sel)showtext 307,this.ox+218,this.oy+160,#s(this.font),c,Equipped To S;
}

function draw(){
  draw_Base();
  draw_Weapons();
  draw_Sel();
  for (this.i=300;this.i<320;this.i++){
    if (this.i>=315){//item subamounts
      changeimgvis this.i,7;
      changeimgzoom this.i,0.5;
    }
    else {
      changeimgvis this.i,(this.i==300)?4:(this.i>=310)?6:5;
      changeimgzoom this.i,(this.i==306 || this.i==307)?this.zoom:1;
    }
    if (this.i == 304 || this.i == 306 || this.i==307 || this.i>= 315)changeimgcolors this.i,0.49,0.35,0.27,;
    else changeimgcolors this.i,1,1,1,1;
  }
}

function close(){;
  hideimgs 300,400;
  enabledefmovement;
  unset disableweapons;
}

if (forceUpdate){
  if (this.sel>=this.wCount-1 && this.sel>0)this.sel--;
  draw();
}

  this.keyh = 1;
  if (keydown(4)){this.key = 4;search();}//d
  else if (keydown(5)){this.key = 5;search();}//s

function search(){
  setstring this.weapon,#I(client.wep#I(client.equip,(this.key==5)?1:0),6);
  if (!hasweapon(#s(this.weapon))){
    triggeraction 0,0,gr.addweapon,#s(this.weapon);
    sleep .1;
  }

  if (playerfreezetime >= 0)return;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),#s(this.weapon))){
      callweapon this.i,weaponfired,#v(this.key);
    }
  }
}

// ===== 01_larency/larency/tricxta_systems__004__39_17.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/tricxta_systems.nw
// npc-index: 4
// header: NPC - 39 17
// image: -
// tile: 39,17
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 083c9977dac9

NPC - 39 17
// Graal2002 NPC by Stefan Knorr
if (created) {
  // Initialize the attributes
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #3,head0.png;
  setcharprop #C0,orange;
  setcharprop #C1,white;
  setcharprop #C2,blue;
  setcharprop #C3,red;
  setcharprop #C4,black;
  setcharprop #2,shield1.gif;
  shieldpower = 1;
  dir = 1;
  setcharprop #P2,blackrocksword.png;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  dir = (dir+1)%4;
  setcharani tricxta_sword,;
  triggeraction x+1.5+vecx(dir)*2,y+2+vecy(dir)*2,Hurt,5,#v(x),#v(y);
  timeout= 2;
}

if (actionHurt){
  if (strequals(#m(-1),hurt))return;

  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    if (strequals(#w(this.i),-systems/statmanager)){
      callweapon this.i,addexp,50;
      callweapon this.i,reducehealth,1;
    }
  }

  this.angle = getangle((x+1.5)-(playerx+1.5),(playery+2)-(y+2));
  this.power = strtofloat(#p(0));
  message owe, that hurt me #v(this.power) points;

  knockback();
  sleep 1;
  message ;
}

if (actionProjectile){
  if (strtofloat(#p(0))==2){
    message owe #p(1), that hurt me #p(2) points!;
  }
}

function knockback(){
  setcharani hurt,;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<2;this.i+=.2){
    this.bx = x + cos(this.angle)*.4;
    this.by = y + sin(this.angle)*.4;

    this.check = 0;
    for (this.tc = 0;this.tc < 4;this.tc++){
      if (onwall(this.bx+.5+(this.tc%2),this.by + 1+ int(this.tc/2)))this.check ++;
    }

    if (this.check == 0){
      x = this.bx;
      y = this.by;
    }
    else break;

    sleep .05;
  }
}

// ===== 01_larency/larency/tricxta_systems__007__23_16.npc.txt =====

NPC - 23 16
// NPC made by tricxta

  toweapons basic_bow;

  if (strtofloat(#p(0))==4)setstring this.data,#s(client.wep#v(strtofloat(#I(client.equip,0))));//key d
  else if (strtofloat(#p(0))==5)setstring this.data,#s(client.wep#v(strtofloat(#I(client.equip,1))));//key s

  getArrows();

  if (this.canshoot == 0){
    setstring this.notify,;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
      if (strequals(#w(this.i),-notify))callweapon this.i,addnotification,"No arrows equiped",#I(this.data,1);
    }
    return;
  }

  freezeplayer .5;

  setani #I(this.data,7),#I(this.data,8);

  this.damage = strtofloat(#I(this.data,9))+strtofloat(#I(client.arrow,2));

  setshootparams 2,#a,#v(this.damage);
  shoot playerx+vecx(playerdir)*1.5,playery+vecy(playerdir)*1.5,playerz,getangle(vecx(playerdir),vecy(playerdir)),0,0,tricxta_arrow1,#I(client.arrow,0);
}

function getArrows(){
  this.find = -1;
  this.i=0;
  while (!strequals(#s(client.wep#v(this.i)),)){
    if (strequals(#I(client.arrow,1),#I(client.wep#v(this.i),0)))this.find = this.i;
    this.i++;
  }

  this.canshoot = 0;
  if (this.find >= 0 && strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.find),2))>0){
    this.canshoot = 1;
    replacestring client.wep#v(this.find),2,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.find),2))-1);

    if (strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.find),2)) <= 0){
      for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
        if (strequals(#w(this.i),-weaponmanager)){callweapon this.i,deleteweapon,#v(this.find);break;}
      }
    }
  }
}

NPCEND

// ===== 01_larency/larency/tricxta_systems__008__29_7.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/tricxta_systems.nw
// npc-index: 8
// header: NPC - 29 7
// image: -
// tile: 29,7
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 93b04f456685

NPC - 29 7
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (!isweapon)toweapons -weaponmanager;
}

if (addweapon){
  this.canStack = strtofloat(#I(client.tempwep,5));
  if (this.canStack==1)stack();
  else place();
}

if (deleteweapon){
  this.index = strtofloat(#p(0));

  //setplayerprop #c,#v(this.index);

  this.count = 0;
  while (!strequals(#s(client.wep#v(this.count)),))this.count++;

  if (this.count>0)setstring client.wep#v(this.index),#s(client.wep#v(this.count-1));//replace the string being deleted with the last one
  setstring client.wep#v(this.count-1),;//delete the last string
}

function stack(){
  this.count = 0;
  this.stack = 0;
  while (!strequals(#s(client.wep#v(this.count)),)){
    if (strequals(#I(client.wep#v(this.count),0),#I(client.tempwep,0))){
      this.newAmount = strtofloat(#I(client.wep#v(this.count),2))+strtofloat(#I(client.tempwep,2));
      this.stack = 1;
      break;
    }
    this.count++;
  }
  setstring client.wep#v(this.count),#s(client.tempwep);
  if (this.stack==1)replacestring client.wep#v(this.count),2,#v(this.newAmount);
}

function place(){
  this.count = 0;
  while (!strequals(#s(client.wep#v(this.count)),))this.count++;
  setstring client.wep#v(this.count),#s(client.tempwep);
  break;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 01_larency/larency/tricxta_systems__009__32_7.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: larency/tricxta_systems.nw
// npc-index: 9
// header: NPC - 32 7
// image: -
// tile: 32,7
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 0019e46042db

NPC - 32 7
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (!isweapon)toweapons -statmanager;
  noplayerkilling;

  if (strequals(#s(client.exp),))setstring client.exp,0,0;//exp, level
  if (strequals(#s(client.health),))setstring client.health,50,50;
  if (strequals(#s(client.mana),))setstring client.mana,75,75;

  if (strequals(#s(client.pFont),))setstring client.pFont,Arial;

  if (strequals(#s(client.respawn),))setstring client.respawn,tricxta_world1_moonlight-inn2.nw,30.5,18;
  setstring this.healStats,sleep,1;

  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.count = (this.count+0.05)%1;//add appropriate health every one second
  this.health = strtofloat(#I(client.health,0));
  if (this.count==0 && strcontains(#s(this.healStats),#m) && this.health < strtofloat(#I(client.health,1))){
    this.addHealth = strtofloat(#I(this.healStats,lindexof(#m,this.healStats)+1));
    replacestring client.health,0,#v(this.health+this.addHealth);
  }

  for (this.i=0;this.i<sarraylen(client.ActiveBoosts);this.i+=4){
    if (strtofloat(#I(client.ActiveBoosts,this.i+3))<timevar){
      for (this.j=0;this.j<4;this.j++)deletestring client.ActiveBoosts,this.i;
    }
  }

  timeout=0.05;
}

if (addexp){
  this.add = strtofloat(#p(0));

  this.cInd = lindexof(Exp,client.ActiveBoosts);
  if (this.cInd>=0)this.add += int(this.add*(strtofloat(#I(client.ActiveBoosts,this.cInd+2))/100));

  replacestring client.exp,0,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.exp,0))+this.add);
  checkExp();
}

if (reducehealth){
  this.damage = strtofloat(#p(0));
  this.knockback = 0;
  damage();
}

if (actionHurt){
  if (level.nopk==1)return;
  this.damage = strtofloat(#p(0));

  this.tx = strtofloat(#p(1));
  this.ty = strtofloat(#p(2));

  this.angle = getangle((playerx+1.5)-(this.tx+1.5),(this.ty+2)-(playery+2));
  this.knockback = 1;

  damage();
}

if (actionProjectile){
  if (strtofloat(#p(0))==2){
    if (level.nopk==1)return;
    this.damage = strtofloat(#p(0));
    this.knockback = 0;
    damage();
  }
}

function damage(){
  if (strequals(#m,hurt) || strtofloat(#I(client.health,0))<= 0)return;
  setani hurt,;
  replacestring client.health,0,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.health,0))-this.damage);
  if (strtofloat(#I(client.health,0))<= 0){//dead
    freezeplayer 2;
    setani dead,;
    sleep 2;
    replacestring client.health,0,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.health,1))/2);
    setani sleep,;
    setlevel2 #I(client.respawn,0),strtofloat(#I(client.respawn,1)),strtofloat(#I(client.respawn,2));
  }
  else if (this.knockback == 1)knockback();
}

function knockback(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<2;this.i+=.4){
    this.bx = playerx + cos(this.angle)*.6;
    this.by = playery + sin(this.angle)*.6;

    this.check = 0;
    for (this.tc = 0;this.tc < 4;this.tc++){
      if (onwall(this.bx+.5+(this.tc%2),this.by + 1+ int(this.tc/2)))this.check ++;
    }

    if (this.check == 0){
      playerx = this.bx;
      playery = this.by;
    }
    else break;

    sleep .05;
  }
}

function checkExp(){
  this.xp = strtofloat(#I(client.exp,0));
  this.level = strtofloat(#I(client.exp,1));

  if (this.xp >= ((this.level^2)*50+50)){//level up
    replacestring client.exp,0,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.exp,0))-((this.level^2)*50+50));
    replacestring client.exp,1,#v(this.level+1);
    setplayerprop #c,Levelled up;
    checkExp();
  }
}

NPCEND
